name: The Spirit World
overview: Scripture reveals the Spirit World as a realm intimately connected to God's nature and His work among humanity. God is Spirit, and true worshipers must engage Him in spirit and truth, emphasizing the spiritual dimension of faith. Jesus teaches that entry into God's kingdom requires new birth through water and the Spirit, highlighting the transformative power of the Holy Spirit. Furthermore, the Spirit, described as the Comforter, is sent by the Father to teach and remind believers of Christ's words, demonstrating the Spirit's ongoing role in guiding and manifesting God's presence to those who love Him.
